scenes.text: Every personal injury case — from the first visit to the final check. This is InjuryCase.
If your PI cases live in spreadsheets and sticky notes, you know the cost: a missed deadline, an attorney waiting on an update, a patient who quietly stops coming in. There's a better way.
Every morning, InjuryCase shows your team exactly what needs attention — gaps in care, overdue referrals, PIP billing deadlines, and settlements still waiting on a check — ranked by urgency.

Every case comes with a built-in PI playbook: the MRI script at visit one, the EMC determination in week one, the orthopedic referral after the MRI, and a re-exam every thirty days. Add your office's own steps, too. It's guidance — your doctors always make the clinical calls.
Run a ten-minute morning huddle from one printable sheet, with an owner for every item — and a morning email digest that never includes patient details.
Protect what every case is worth. See PIP remaining and medical bills against the policy limits, with soft warnings before a big reduction surprises you.
Keep attorneys in the loop in one click — status, treatment-complete, and reduction letters on your letterhead, with outreach logged in neutral, records-safe wording.
Built in Florida and ready for your state, with PIP, no-fault, lawsuit-threshold, and lien rules configured for twenty-seven states plus D.C.
HIPAA-ready from day one: a Business Associate Agreement, two-factor sign-in for every user, encryption, and daily backups — shaped by more than ten years of personal injury attorney input.
Plans start at thirty-nine dollars a month, with a fourteen-day free trial and no credit card required.
Put every PI case on track this week. Start your free trial at injurycase.com, or email support at injurycase.com to request a demo.
